summary: BLOCK / REQUEST_CHANGES for PR #297 exact head ac8b0d1d6f27305da551c0ed3fb46be4a4c53af1. The bootstrap context regressions only search for RunService:IsServer()/IsClient() tokens, so they remain green if the fail-closed assert is weakened to an unused assignment, warning, or other non-gating expression. Strengthen the source-contract check to lock actual fail-closed guard structure/behavior. Existing server-only module ownership assertions are otherwise directionally sound; no real two-client Studio evidence is claimed.
evidence: tests/hero_gate_contract_integration.luau currently checks serverBootstrap:find("RunService:IsServer()", 1, true) and the analogous client token only.

Current production bootstraps use assert(RunService:IsServer(), "server bootstrap must run on server") and assert(RunService:IsClient(), "client bootstrap must run on client"), which is stronger than the regression currently protects.
GitHub review 4903873018 records the exact-head blocker; GitHub cannot submit REQUEST_CHANGES from the same repository account, so the durable swarm verdict is authoritative for this audit slot.
